text: Evidence is limited to Insect bite reaction, but the page branch covers spider bites too.

Type and trigger are right and every red-box criterion is listed except one: the anaphylaxis bullet's 'or exposure to possible allergen' (footnote 3: medications, new food or insect bite/sting within the last few hours) is not checked for anywhere. Footnote 2's components of 'shock likely' (pulse >= 100, respiratory rate > 30, confusion/restlessness) are also not represented, though pulse and RR are routine vitals. 'Muscle weakness' should be 'Asthenia' (see c013).

Follows the page's literal wording (any one sudden-onset item -> 'anaphylaxis likely'), so the or-structure is faithful, but it fires probable anaphylaxis on a single sudden-onset cough, nausea or diarrhoea after a bite, which is far looser than the anaphylaxis page (28) it points to; a clinician should confirm. It also omits the bullet's last alternative, 'exposure to possible allergen'.

Urgent is justified by 'Give urgent attention' and the (and trigger (or ...)) shape, the spider-bite sub-and and the SBP < 80 measurement are faithful. Structural gap: 'Toxic effect of venom' (venom in eyes) is not a descendant of 'Bite - wound' or 'Venomous sting' (confirmed with is_a), so a patient with venom in the eyes and no recorded bite never satisfies the outer trigger even though the page red-boxes 'Venom in eyes' on its own. 'Poisoning due to bite of Scorpiones' is a descendant of 'Bite - wound', so scorpion is fine. Allergen exposure reaches this rule only via (active_condition Anaphylaxis), which itself omits it.

check_for list includes extensive local response, erythema, warm skin and pain of skin (non-urgent papular urticaria/cellulitis cues) so the task would prompt urgent checks for non-urgent signs. Trigger requires a bite/sting concept, yet 'Snake bite even if bite not seen' and the spider/scorpion qualifiers are not gated by it on the page. Spider bite listed in check_for without its drooling/restlessness/cramp conjunction (acceptable for a check list). Management steps (pressure, fluids, wound wash, tetanus) not encoded, fine for a check task.

Page-supported (any sudden-onset sign with bite/sting, anaphylaxis likely, ->28). 'Exposure to possible allergen' (medications, new food, insect bite/sting within hours) is on the page as a trigger but not encoded. Probable is justified by 'likely'.
